class.name: Box3DHingeJoint
class.brief_description: A revolute joint: the bodies rotate about this node's local Z axis.
class.description: A hinge. [member body_b] rotates relative to [member body_a] about [b]this node's local Z axis[/b] (the blue arrow of the move gizmo), around this node's origin -- so aim the joint by rotating the joint node. Doors, levers, wheels on a fixed axle, and ragdoll elbows and knees once [member limit_enabled] is on.

method.name: get_angle
method.description: The hinge's current angle in radians, body B relative to body A.

method.name: get_motor_torque
method.description: Torque the motor applied on the last step, in newton-metres. Compare it against [member max_motor_torque] to tell a motor that is working from one that is saturated.

members.member: Restricts the hinge angle to [member lower_limit] .. [member upper_limit].
Lowest allowed hinge angle, in radians, relative to the frame the joint was created in.
Torque budget the motor may spend to reach [member motor_speed], in newton-metres. At 0 the motor is on but powerless -- this is the usual reason a motor 'does nothing'.
Drives the hinge toward [member motor_speed], within [member max_motor_torque].
Target angular speed of the motor, in radians per second. Sign picks the direction, reversed when [member body_b] is empty in the same way as [member target_angle].
Damping ratio of the spring, non-dimensional. 1.0 is critical damping (no overshoot); below 1 the joint oscillates. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.
Adds a spring pulling the hinge back toward its rest angle.
Stiffness of the spring, in cycles per second. Higher is stiffer. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on.

Angle the spring drives toward, in radians, measured as body B relative to body A about the hinge axis -- the same convention as [method get_angle]. Only used while [member spring_enabled] is on. [b]With [member body_b] empty the sign is reversed[/b]: the world anchor takes the place of body B, so a positive target turns the body the other way. See [Box3DJoint]'s description.
Highest allowed hinge angle, in radians.
